---
description: "Prompt source rules, versioning, and Phase 0 boundaries"
applyTo: "libs/prompts/**"
---

- Prompts are source code: versioned, reviewed and tested.
- No Scientist or SA runtime prompt implementation in Phase 0.
- AI output is never scientific evidence.
- Never embed secrets, provider credentials or copyrighted corpus text.
- Structured-output contracts must be defined before future product prompts.
- Prompt-injection boundaries must remain explicit in later phases.
- Prompt changes require golden or evaluation coverage once available.
